title: Herero and Nama genocide
summary: German colonial forces under Lothar von Trotha drove the Herero into the desert, and survivors were held in concentration camps; an estimated 40,000-80,000 Herero and 10,000 Nama died. Germany acknowledged in 2015 that it was genocide.
why: Colonial mass killing in Africa that Germany formally acknowledged a century later.

notes.problem: Source says these numbers 'died' (desert, camps, disease), not all 'killed' by Trotha's troops; state the means soberly.
